headline: Police dismantle KillSec ransomware gang, arrest three including alleged teen leader
summary: An international operation called KillSwitch seized the KillSec ransomware gang's data leak site and servers, arresting three people and identifying a 16-year-old as the group's alleged administrator. The Register reports the seized site held at least 110 TB of stolen data.

claims.statement: An international police operation dismantled the KillSec ransomware gang, seizing its leak site and servers and arresting three people, including an alleged 16-year-old administrator.

sources.quote: An international law enforcement operation dubbed "Operation KillSwitch" seized the KillSec ransomware gang's data leak site and servers, led to three arrests, and identified a 16-year-old as the group's alleged administrator.
Teen suspected of running KillSec ransomware group as cops seize servers, arrest three

claims.statement: The seized leak site held at least 110 TB of stolen data.
